name_zh: 美国·富兰克林·罗斯福：新政二战与四大自由联合国轮椅最长
name_en: USA Franklin Roosevelt: New Deal WWII & Four Freedoms UN Wheelchair Longest
description_zh: 富兰克林·罗斯福 (1882-1945) 美国第32任总统 (1933-1945)，新政拯救大萧条经济，二战领导同盟国胜利，四大自由奠定联合国人权基础，轮椅总统四连任最长执政。
description_en: Franklin Roosevelt (1882-1945) US 32nd President (1933-1945), New Deal saved Great Depression economy, WWII led Allies victory, Four Freedoms founded UN human rights basis, wheelchair President four terms longest tenure.
reason_zh: 罗斯福代表危机领导力如何通过国家干预主义重塑资本主义与国际秩序，展示了残疾身份如何转化为共情领导力资产，其四大自由与联合国构想定义了战后自由国际秩序核心价值。
reason_en: Roosevelt represents how crisis leadership reshapes capitalism and international order through state interventionism, demonstrating how disability identity transforms into empathetic leadership asset, his Four Freedoms and UN vision defining post-war liberal international order core values.
steps_zh: 研究罗斯福早年哈佛与小儿麻痹症轮椅生涯
分析1933年新政百日法案与社会保障体系建立
探讨1941年四大自由国情咨文与珍珠港参战
评估雅尔塔会议联合国构想与1945年逝世未见成立
总结新政二战四大自由联合国轮椅最长对战后世界秩序的决定性塑造
steps_en: Study Roosevelt early Harvard and polio wheelchair life
Analyze 1933 New Deal Hundred Days and Social Security establishment
Explore 1941 Four Freedoms State of Union and Pearl Harbor entry
Evaluate Yalta Conference UN vision and 1945 death before UN founding
Summarize New Deal WWII Four Freedoms UN wheelchair longest decisive shaping of post-war world order
expected_zh: 掌握国家干预主义如何在危机中重塑经济与社会契约，理解残疾领袖共情力如何转化为跨阶级跨国界团结资源，评估罗斯福遗产对战后福利国家与联合国体系的双重奠基。
expected_en: Master how state interventionism reshapes economy and social contract in crisis, grasp how disabled leader empathy transforms into cross-class cross-border solidarity resource, evaluate Roosevelt dual foundation for post-war welfare state and UN system.
case_zh: 1933 新政；1941 四大自由；1945 雅尔塔/逝世；轮椅四连任。新政二战四大自由联合国范式永存。
case_en: 1933 New Deal; 1941 Four Freedoms; 1945 Yalta/death; wheelchair four terms. New Deal WWII Four Freedoms UN paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: American Liberalism / New Deal Liberalism / Internationalism
cross_cultural_impact: New Deal; Four Freedoms; UN; WWII leadership; disability leadership
